release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.41 adds the Generator workspace between Profiles and Accounts. Generator uses the same retailer -> named group -> account task hierarchy style as Tasks for Walmart, Target, and Amazon, supports per-task proxy assignment, isolated Chrome/Edge/Brave browser profiles, headless signup-field autofill preparation, headed review handoff, normal verification/challenge detection, queued account preparation, and focused regression coverage.
